evaluation.name: Project-defined adjacent-pair supplementary experiment
evaluation.photometry: Grayscale valid-overlap PSNR/SSIM, 4px erosion, successful estimates only.
evaluation.comparability: 相邻图像对补充实验，非 APAP 原论文 RMSE 协议。

dataset_protocol: All adjacent image pairs in the 8 sequences from the three official archives; own pair protocol, not an official leaderboard split.

xfeat.variant: sparse detectAndCompute; no XFeat* or LighterGlue
xfeat.timing: Model initialization and worker warmup excluded; pair I/O and inference included.
